prompt:
Use case: pixel-art angry speech-mouth atlas for Daggerfall Unity NPC 081.
Image 1 is the exact 3x3 repeated-original lower-face grid and layout reference. Image 2 is the exact native original lower half. Image 3 is the complete original portrait and palette authority.
Create one complete 3x3 atlas of nine angry speech poses, exact row-major order A B C / D E F / G H X. Equal full lower-half crops, identical scale, framing, face geometry and mouth position. Preserve hair, nose, cheeks, jaw, chin, neck, background and original soft pixel-art style.
Articulation: A = closed tense lips; B = small visible upper teeth; C = small open mouth; D = wide open speech mouth; E = rounded open mouth; F = puckered narrow opening; G = parted lips with small upper teeth; H = open mouth with a small tongue cue; X = closed resting lips. Each shape must be visibly distinct and anatomically natural at the portrait's original small lip width. No giant mouths. Teeth only in B and G; tongue cue only in H.
Emotion: controlled anger through pressed lip corners and subtle tension in closed forms. Do not turn A or X into a comic frown.
Palette: match exact subdued original terracotta-brown lips and muted skin. No lipstick-red, no orange skin, no saturation or contrast increase. Keep teeth and inner-mouth colors soft and low contrast, consistent with original.
Keep native 64x29 lower-cell proportions and 3x3 grid. Change lips and mouth interiors only; preserve surrounding half-frame pixels and all cell positions. No heavy outlines, hard shadows, smudging, blur, text, labels, borders, gutters, extra cells or watermark.
visibleIssues: A-H/X articulation is differentiated; requested teeth B/G and tongue H cues are present. Lips appear redder and skin warmer/oranger than original at enlarged view; palette drift remains open. No reroll.
